Limbic Cartel Scavenger.dossier: A raft scavenger with cheap grafts and a calm that isn’t his own. He wants the implants in your new body.
lines: That one was on the slab this morning. I sold its eyes.
Stay down. Stay down, you're worth more down.
lateLines: Another one walking. Who's buying them back?
Limbic Cartel Scavenger.firstSight: They take things off the dead. I am one of the dead.

SALV Boarder.dossier: Crane limbs and a clamped spine, more boat than person. Sweeps wide, then hooks you in.

moves.name: Crane Hook
moves.description: A cargo hook on a line: it catches the first body and reels it in.

lines: Dead don't stand. Dead don't stand. Dead don't—
I hooked you out of the water myself. You were cold.
lateLines: They keep coming up out of the bilge now. Same eyes.
SALV Boarder.firstSight: Its arm is a crane. I think it chose this. I think it was told it chose this.

Pump-Fleet Cadre.dossier: Pumps thud where her heart should be. She stays standing long after she should fall.
lines: Mother says the sea keeps what it takes. Why did it give you back?
Your heart's stopped. Mine's a pump. Which of us is the machine?
lateLines: Mother warned us. She said the drowned would learn to walk.
Pump-Fleet Cadre.firstSight: Pumps where the heart should be. They move like they are praying.

Ghost-MIL Infiltrator.dossier: Ports in the skull, wired from old control rigs. Jams your sensors from range. Fragile up close.

moves.name: Signal Bleed
moves.description: A shot from across the water that keeps hurting.

lines: No pulse. No signal I know. What are you running?
Something's behind your eyes. It isn't you.
lateLines: I've logged you before. Different face. Same noise.
Ghost-MIL Infiltrator.firstSight: Something is in that skull too. It looks out at me the way I look out at it.

Non-Continuous Raider.dossier: Scarred, half-starved and fast. Takes whatever it can carry, and hits hard.
lines: I've stripped a hundred like you. None of them looked at me.
You're not continuous. Nobody's continuous. But you're dead.
lateLines: I cut one like you open last week. It was empty.
Non-Continuous Raider.firstSight: It has cut itself apart to sell the pieces. There is not much left to sell.

CBN Extraction Surgeon.dossier: Clean hands and a folding surgery kit. Sedates first, harvests after.
lines: I signed your certificate. Lie down. Please lie down.
There's nothing in there. I took it out myself.
lateLines: They're all walking out of my theatre now. All of them.
CBN Extraction Surgeon.firstSight: Clean hands. The cleanest thing I have seen here, and the most frightening.

IOA Interdiction Officer.dossier: A stamp, a uniform and a long gun. Denies passage from range, by the book.
lines: Unregistered cadaver in motion. Requesting— I don't know what to request.
You're on the manifest as cargo. Cargo doesn't fight.
lateLines: Second report this week. They're not listening to me.
IOA Interdiction Officer.firstSight: It enforces a law. I cannot find the law. I can only find the gun.

Tianxia Compliance Unit.dossier: A labour frame set to keeping order. Cools your systems to slow you down.
lines: Units don't wake. Units don't wake.
Your shift ended. Your shift ended. Your shift—
lateLines: Error. Error. The decommissioned are reporting for work.
Tianxia Compliance Unit.firstSight: Forty bodies, one rhythm. Nobody inside is keeping time.

Helix Continuity Warden.dossier: Heavy housing and a door to guard. The weapon came from somewhere else. Hard to move.
lines: You're on no list. Nothing that walks is on no list.
Continuity broken. I can't find where you begin.
lateLines: Your record ends three times. How many more?
Helix Continuity Warden.firstSight: It guards a door with nothing behind it.

Volkov Operator.dossier: A full set of operator limbs on a tired body. Precise, brutal, and very hard to put down.
lines: Whatever's wearing you, it isn't the man.
I've seen chips do a lot of things. Not this.
lateLines: They told us to expect you. They didn't say how many.
Volkov Operator.firstSight: Its limbs are worth more than its life. It knows the price of each.

Cartel Enforcer.dossier: A collector, far heavier than anything this body can handle. It keeps count.
lines: The debt died with the body. So why is the body walking?
You owe nothing. Dead men owe nothing. Lie down.
lateLines: How many times do I have to collect on you?
Cartel Enforcer.firstSight: It counts. Everything it sees, it counts.

Unregistered Operator.dossier: No name, no maker’s mark, no record anywhere. A ghost story with a body count.
lines: So it's true. Something's riding the dead out here.
No maker, no mark. You and me both.
lateLines: I've been following you through bodies. You leave a trail.
Unregistered Operator.firstSight: No name, no maker, no mark. Like me.

The Fitter.dossier: Runs the foundry, fitting limbs to whoever pays. Has fitted most of them to itself.

enrage.line: The Fitter bolts a fresh leg on mid-fight. It moves faster now.

lines: Hold still. I've fitted worse than you to the living.
That chip's in a dead man. I can hear it ticking.
lateLines: You again, in someone else. I'll have that chip out this time.
The Fitter.firstSight: It replaces itself one piece at a time. I wonder if it noticed when it stopped being a person.

The Listener.dossier: Something living in a drowned body at the bottom of the spire, wired into every chip on the water.

enrage.line: The Listener pulls power from every chip on the water. Its wounds start closing.

lines: There you are. We've been listening to you wake up, over and over.
Every body you take, we hear it. Come down.
lateLines: How many corpses now? We counted all of them.
The Listener.firstSight: It doesn't look at me. It looks at the chip, and the chip looks back.

Hull-Bound Deckhand.dossier: Wired into the boat it works on; it brought the anchor chain with it. Slow, heavy, hard to move.
lines: Off the deck. Off. The deck is mine, I am the deck.
You don't drown. Why don't you drown?
lateLines: Another one up from the water. They all walk like you.
Hull-Bound Deckhand.firstSight: Cables run from its back into the hull. When the boat rocks, it rocks.

Silt Diver.dossier: Comes up out of the mud with a knife and goes back under. Fast and fragile.
lines: Down here the water remembers everyone.
I saw you sink. I saw you.
lateLines: The mud is full of you. Every tide brings one up.
Silt Diver.firstSight: Its lungs are wrong. It breathes the mud like it's air.

Checkpoint Scanner.dossier: Carries the light that reads chips. Being read slows you down; the baton does the rest.
lines: Hold still. You're already on file.
The record says you passed through. Twice.
lateLines: Your record is very long now.
Checkpoint Scanner.firstSight: A light sweeps over me. Something on the other side of it says yes, that's the one.

Record Courier.dossier: Carries sealed cases between the checkpoints, and shoots anyone who asks what's in them.
lines: Not for you. None of it is for you.
Sign here. Doesn't matter what name.
lateLines: There's a case with your name on it. More than one.
Record Courier.firstSight: The case is chained to its wrist. The wrist is not its own.

The Recurring.dossier: A body that moves the way you move, a step behind. It doesn't speak. It knows your swing.
The Recurring.firstSight: It turns its head the way I would. It was waiting for me to do it first.

Checkpoint Commander.dossier: Runs the channel and the scan light. Every body that passes is stamped, and some are kept.
lines: Papers. You don't have papers. You don't have a face.
We copied you once. It was quick.
lateLines: We have you on file from before. And before that.
Checkpoint Commander.firstSight: Behind it, racks of something glowing, one light per body that ever came through.

Silt Matriarch.dossier: Mother of the divers, and older than the channel. She drags you down into her mud.
lines: Come down, little one. Everyone comes down.
I raised forty in this mud. You'll make forty-one.
lateLines: You keep coming up. I keep pulling you down.
Silt Matriarch.firstSight: She is mostly mud now. The rest of her is watching me.

The Echo.dossier: Wears what your last body wore and fights the way you fought. It doesn't hesitate where you would.
lines: I was here first.
You left this body. I picked it up.
lateLines: How many of us now?
The Echo.firstSight: It moves the way I move. It's wearing what I wore.

The Living Vessel.dossier: A captain grown into her own ship: ribs for a keel, cables for hair. The deck moves when she does.

enrage.line: The Living Vessel draws water up through her hull. Her wounds close over with rust.

lines: Off my deck. My deck is me.
You took a body. I took a boat. We're the same.
lateLines: Still taking bodies? I only ever needed the one.
The Living Vessel.firstSight: She doesn't stand on the ship. She is the ship. I can feel the hull breathe.

The Registrar.dossier: Fused to the scanning array at the end of the channel. It holds every record it ever made, yours included.

enrage.line: The Registrar opens your file. It starts reading it aloud.

lines: Ah. You. We've met. You weren't there for it.
There's more than one of you on file. Did no one tell you?
lateLines: Every time you die, we file another.
The Registrar.firstSight: It has my shape on a screen. More than one copy of it.

Continuation Officer.dossier: Would rather hold you than hurt you. Nets you, bats you, then waits for you to be counted.
lines: Back to your pod. Nobody's angry.
Count again. Count again.
lateLines: The count's off again. It's always you.
Continuation Officer.firstSight: It says sorry while it swings. I think it means it.

Sleepwalker.dossier: Up out of its pod and still asleep, fighting something in its dream. You're in the way.
lines: Mum? Mum, the water's coming in.
I've done my years. I've done my years.
lateLines: You're in my dream again. You're always in it now.
Sleepwalker.firstSight: Its eyes are open and nobody is looking out of them. I know that look. I've worn it.

Night Orderly.dossier: Moves sleepers between wards at night. Puts you under with a dart and wheels you back.
lines: Wrong ward. You're in the wrong ward.
Lie down. It's easier lying down.
lateLines: I keep wheeling you back. You keep getting up.
Night Orderly.firstSight: It checks a number on its wrist and then checks me. The numbers don't match.

Fan Technician.dossier: Keeps the ceiling fans turning and the warm air moving. Turns the hot air on you.
lines: Feel that? That's them. Every one of them, warm.
The fans never stop. If they stop, we all cook.
lateLines: You run hot. Hotter than they do.
Fan Technician.firstSight: The air it breathes out is warm in a way air shouldn't be. It's been through people first.

Lattice Thief.dossier: Cuts the charge out of sleepers to sell. Quick with a blade and quicker to run.
lines: You've got a good lattice in you. Hold still.
They don't feel it. They don't feel anything.
lateLines: You're warm. The warm ones always have charge.
Lattice Thief.firstSight: It holds a cut-out piece of someone up to the light, and the light comes through it, blue.

Academy Graduate.dossier: Trained in twenty minutes and certain of everything. Precise, fast and very new.
lines: I know exactly what you are. I downloaded it this morning.
Section four. Unauthorised occupancy. I know this one.
lateLines: They didn't put you in the training. Why didn't they put you in?
Academy Graduate.firstSight: It knows everything it was given and nothing it wasn't. I recognise that.

Kizuna Auditor.dossier: Checks that every pod runs certified software. Looks right through you to the chip.
lines: Unsigned process detected.
You aren't on the manifest. You aren't on anything.
lateLines: Unsigned again. Still running. How are you still running?
Kizuna Auditor.firstSight: It isn't looking at the body. It's reading what's inside the skull, and frowning.

Ward Sister.dossier: Runs the first ward. Knows every sleeper by number, and knows yours is wrong.
lines: Back in. I don't care whose body.
I've a hundred and fifteen to see to. You're a hundred and sixteen.
lateLines: You again. In 4471 this time. Get back in.
Ward Sister.firstSight: Keys on a chain round her neck, one for every pod. She touches them like a rosary.

Academy Prefect.dossier: Top of a class that lasted twenty minutes. Fights from a manual written for something else.
lines: There's no chapter on you. I checked.
Stand where the diagram says to stand.
lateLines: They've added you to the course now. You're a case study.
Academy Prefect.firstSight: It moves like a demonstration. I wonder who it learned from, and if they were ever asked.

The Long Sleeper.dossier: Under so long the dream has become them. The dream is made of your memories, and so is the fight.
lines: I've been dreaming you. Rafts. A king. The sea.
Stay. It's nicer in here than out there.
lateLines: You were in it again last night. Different body. Same you.
The Long Sleeper.firstSight: This is the raft. The throne. The King's room. But it's wrong, and it's facing the other way.

The Count.dossier: The officer who keeps the count. It has been one over for a long time, and it knows which one.

enrage.line: The Count stops counting. It just looks at you.

lines: Eleven thousand five hundred and one.
There should be eleven thousand five hundred. There's you.
lateLines: One over. Always one over. Every time you come back.
The Count.firstSight: It clicks a counter in its hand every time I move. It has been clicking a long time.

The First Sleeper.dossier: The oldest sleeper, under longer than the town has stood. Every dream in the ward runs through it.

enrage.line: The First Sleeper wakes, a little. Every pod in the ward goes dark at once.

lines: What do you dream of, little light?
Nothing? Nothing at all? Then what are you?
lateLines: Still nothing. You still dream of nothing.
The First Sleeper.firstSight: It is so old it has forgotten it was ever awake. It is the only thing here that frightens me.

Terrace Worker.dossier: Works the terraces on a schedule it can't hear. Stops dead when the drones pass, then swings.
lines: Not yet. Not until the drones have gone.
We stop when they stop. Why didn't you stop?
lateLines: You never stop when the drones pass. Everyone else does.
Terrace Worker.firstSight: It stopped mid-step, with all the others, for a sound I didn't hear. Then it started again.

Seeding Drone.dossier: A drone that seeds the clouds and anything under them. Fragile, fast and never alone for long.
Seeding Drone.firstSight: It turned to look at me the same moment as all the others. They share one neck.

Dam Keeper.dossier: Big, slow, built into the dam's machinery. Shoves you toward the edge and lets the wind do the rest.
lines: Over you go. The water's a long way down.
The dam holds. I hold. You don't.
lateLines: You climbed back up again. Nobody climbs back up.
Dam Keeper.firstSight: Half of it is the dam. When the sluices open, it shudders.

Air-Lift Rigger.dossier: Clips itself to the air-lift lines and swings. Hooks you in, then lets go.
lines: Hold on to something.
Up here the wind decides. Not me. Not you.
lateLines: The wind keeps bringing you back. It likes you.
Air-Lift Rigger.firstSight: It leans into the wind like a person leans on a friend.

Chamber Technician.dossier: Tends the cloud chambers. Vents cold air at you until you can't feel your hands.
lines: Mind the readings. You're throwing them off.
There's a cloud in every chamber. There's something in you.
lateLines: The readings go wrong whenever you're near.
Chamber Technician.firstSight: Behind it, in a glass room, a cloud is being grown. It's the most careful thing I've seen anyone do.

Valley Raider.dossier: Came up from the dry valley with a blade and a grudge. Fights like there's nothing left to lose.
lines: You work for it. You all work for it.
It hasn't rained on us in nine years.
lateLines: You again. Climbing up. Never down to us.
Valley Raider.firstSight: Its lips are cracked. It looks up at the clouds the way you'd look at a thief.

Shift Foreman.dossier: Keeps the terrace crews in step with a whistle you can't hear. Makes you feel the rhythm too.
lines: Step. Step. Step. You're out of step.
Everyone keeps time up here. Everyone.
lateLines: Out of step again. You're always out of step.
Shift Foreman.firstSight: Its mouth moves in a count. Every worker on the terrace moves on the count.

Ghost-MIL Captain.dossier: Rides a stolen seeding drone and wants the control rig in your skull. Strikes from above, then from everywhere.
lines: That rig in your head. I want it.
We took the drones. We'll take the weather next.
lateLines: Still carrying that rig? Still mine.
Ghost-MIL Captain.firstSight: It flies a drone like it's riding a horse it stole. Its own skull has the same ports mine does.

Drone Shepherd.dossier: Walks the summit with a flock of drones turning around it. When it points, they all come.
lines: They follow me. Who follows you?
Lie down. Let them pass.
lateLines: They know you now. They turn when you turn.
Drone Shepherd.firstSight: The drones circle it the way birds circle a field. They've never once circled me.

The Overseer.dossier: Keeps every worker on the mountain in step. Its own body moves to a beat it's never once missed.
lines: You're late. You've been late your whole life.
There's a beat. You've been dancing to it since you woke.
lateLines: Late again. Still dancing.
The Overseer.firstSight: It taps a foot I can't hear. I realise I've been walking in time with it all the way up.

The Storm Tower.dossier: An air-lift tower that breathes cloud, and the crew fused into its crane arm. It moves the wind.

enrage.line: The Storm Tower opens every vent and leans into its own wind. It moves faster now.

lines: Breathe in. Breathe out. That's the weather.
I am the weather's lungs.
lateLines: The wind brought you back. It always brings you back to me.
The Storm Tower.firstSight: It inhales and the clouds come in. It exhales and the wind goes out. I'm standing in its breath.

The Weather.dossier: The machine that runs the mountain, fought as a room of drones moving in perfect rhythm. It speaks to you like family.

enrage.line: The Weather loses the beat. For a moment every drone is out of step, and it is furious.

lines: You're home. You're late, but you're home.
Every choice you made was a nudge. Ours.
lateLines: Back again. We knew you would be. We always know.
The Weather.firstSight: Every drone turns to me at once, and something in my own head turns with them.

patchworkKing.dossier: He sits on a throne of other people’s parts and wears a crown of grafts. Someone built him once, then threw him away. Three phases.
monologue: The Patchwork King rises. Everything you carry -- he has already counted.
He built his throne from the parts others left behind.
You still breathe. He finds that... inconvenient.
There is no negotiation. Only settlement.
patchworkKing.firstSight: A crown of other people's parts. It wears them like it earned them.
